source_model: uniform circular Lambertian emitter; paraxial geometric propagation
retinal_coverage_definition: source image disk covers the specified posterior-pole disk
assumptions: The effective eye is represented by a rotationally symmetric paraxial thin lens.
The reported effective focal length is the air-equivalent focal length; baseline power is 1000/f_mm diopters.
The reduced retina distance is calibrated to the baseline effective focal length, separating principal-plane offset from reported full axial length.
Accommodation changes effective eye power while retinal position remains fixed.
The source is spatially uniform and circular; absolute radiometric power and tissue safety are out of scope because the PPT supplies no source flux or exposure time.
The -15 D external lens value resolves the likely missing minus sign in slide 5.
